_doc: Expected verdict per example (lane #860; re-cut from the 854 lane expectations under design record R11 and §4.2). valid = passes the schema, the save rules and the product text rules. schema = fails ONLY at the schema, with an error of the named keyword at the named instance path. save = the save-rule refusal codes are EXACTLY [code]. product = passes the schema and the save rules and is refused by the product rule named (code, reason, path) - the JS reference stops at the save rules, so these are product-only.

valid/markup-title.json.note: refused at the schema pattern under the 854 lane D8; valid under design record R11 (< and > allowed, escaped at render)

valid/script-in-display-name.json.note: refused at the schema pattern under the 854 lane D8; valid under design record R11 (< and > allowed, escaped at render)

invalid/display-name-61-astral.json.note: 61 code points pass the schema maxLength 120; 122 UTF-16 units exceed the product bound (DocumentRules.texts, layer 2)

invalid/display-name-blank.json.note: passes the schema minLength 1; the product refuses a blank name (DocumentRules.texts, layer 2)

invalid/line-fields-with-color.json.note: G1: the fields are the series, so color is refused

invalid/bar-log-stacked.json.note: G4: refused on a stacked value

invalid/line-log-domain.json.note: G4: domain[0] must be greater than 0

invalid/line-log-domain-huge.json.note: G4: a number past a double's range (1e400 reads as Infinity) is not an increasing finite range

invalid/bar-tooltip-unknown.json.note: G7: the detail's field is not a column

invalid/bar-zero-false.json.note: G8: false refused on bar (the bar's encoding is a oneOf of its two orientations)

invalid/line-temporal-band.json.note: record §4.2: a temporal x has ONE form on the line family

invalid/line-band-sort-by-total.json.note: a line's band x sorts by orderSort only: no by-total order

invalid/area-band-sort-object.json.note: an area's band x sort is orderSort: an object is refused

invalid/bar-legend-direct.json.note: direct is admitted on line and area only

invalid/line-x-number-on-string.json.note: a quantitative position on a STRING column

invalid/area-x-time-on-string.json.note: a temporal position on a STRING column

valid/bar-shade-diverging.json.note: lane 1053 D9: turned round; refused at the schema (const at /config/encoding/color/scale) under lane 1050, drawn since the two-sided scale

valid/bar-shade-diverging-mid.json.note: lane 1053 D9: a diverging shade with mid 100

invalid/bar-shade-sequential-mid.json.note: lane 1053 D9: mid is admitted with diverging only (the skeleton)

invalid/bar-shade-mid-infinite.json.note: lane 1053 D9: a mid past a double's range

invalid/scatter-y-temporal.json.note: brief 1062 D2: y is a number axis (#1067: no time form on the value side)

invalid/scatter-x-nominal.json.note: a position is quantitative or temporal

invalid/scatter-log-domain-zero.json.note: G4: a log range is greater than 0

invalid/scatter-shade-text.json.note: a shade on a text column

invalid/scatter-unknown-field.json.note: a size field is a column of the input
